page.overview:
Who is Eric Griffiths?

Eric Donald Griffiths (31 October 1940 — 29 January 2005) was a British musician, best known as the guitarist in the original formation of The Quarrymen in November of 1956, until he was fired from the band by Nigel Walley in the summer of 1958 to be replaced by George Harrison.
